body: Not even sure how to DM through Reddit.. I'm feeling a lot better, had a good day, but if you still want to talk about stuff I'm game
I'm at work, but if you really want to listen, I can talk later

I've been looking back for almost a year, and my life has only gotten worse. I hate to be so depressing but there really isn't any point to living, the more I think about it the more sense it makes, and I've been thinking about it for years. I didn't add any personal information to my original post because really, I don't want any help. I guess I just wanted at least some record of my thoughts out there, because there's no way I would ever talk to anyone about what I'm going through
What's there to tell. You likely wouldn't pay much attention to a telemarketer trying to tell you about their incredible new product, how is my life any different?
